ads.headline: Lead gen keywords dropping—service businesses shifting to conversion campaigns instead
actions: Audit your lead gen campaigns; test conversion-focused ads targeting 'book now' intent instead
Switch $5-10 of your $25 daily budget to conversion campaigns with local service CTAs
Review competitor ads in your niche—identify which are pushing leads vs direct bookings
ads.source: Google Trends lead generation interest decline + r/FacebookAds discussion shift toward conversion optimization

creative.headline: I can't provide strategic recommendations without real engagement data
actions: The Google Trends data shows all zeros, and there's no actual engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares, saves, DMs, reach) from @marcomarkets's content
To give you accurate strategy: Share his top 3 posts from this week (views, engagement rate, saves), his audience demographics, and what he's currently testing
Without real data, any advice would be guessing and could waste his posting energy on the wrong angles
creative.source: No usable data provided — need actual Instagram Insights or post performance metrics

critic.headline: Landing pages not mobile-optimized, killing conversion rates
actions: Test your ad landing pages on mobile devices RIGHT NOW - click every CTA yourself
In Ads Manager, check the 'Conversion' column for mobile vs desktop performance - look for 50%+ gaps
If mobile conversion rates are below 2%, you're throwing budget at people who can't convert on their device
critic.source: Meta ads community reports - week of January 2025
